page.content:
Hat-bladed Shaolin and Liu Kang's closest rival-brother.

How Kung Lao connects

  • Location: Earthrealm — Kung Lao fights for Earthrealm beside Liu Kang.
  • Location: Wu Shi Academy — Kung Lao trained at the Wu Shi Academy with Liu Kang.

What is Kung Lao?

Kung Lao is the Shaolin who fights beside Liu Kang, wearing the razor hat of a Great Kung Lao ancestor who once won Mortal Kombat for Earthrealm.

Key threads lead to Earthrealm and Wu Shi Academy.
